about: Manual review of web UI v2 (docs/dev/accessibility.md, Manual review). Fill in fill_in per session and result per check: true = holds, false = fails (give issue), null + reason = not applicable, null without reason = not done yet. Do not change the other fields.
setup: Run ekte serve and open http://127.0.0.1:8000/. Run one audit so that History, Analytics and a report exist, and add one monitor. Use the UI language and theme the session names unless a check names another.

setup.label: Desktop browser, keyboard and mouse, no screen reader
setup.browser: Chrome or another Chromium browser (for the DevTools rendering emulations)

setup.label: Phone or tablet with a touch screen
